annotationScope: Fictional resume-to-job examples annotated from their text alone. Contact values retain exact source spelling and case. Extraction includes every explicit positive candidate skill in the public canonical vocabulary, normalizes the supplied aliases, and excludes a skill when the resume explicitly both claims and denies that candidate skill. A requested skill with that conflict is uncertain; a denial without a positive candidate claim is missing. Names, employer names, third-party statements, copied instructions, and aspirations do not establish candidate skills. Required and preferred requirements are labeled only as stated in each job description.
